 3 die of dengue, 1,598 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll reaches 502 this year 
 Published : 16 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 16 November 2026, 17:30
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least three dengue patients died and 1,598 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, two were reported in Dhaka and one in Khulna division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the total death toll this year has risen to 502 while the cumulative number of cases reached 164,107.
 Currently, 5,617 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
